notes: Go T2 (`bgraph-eval t2 --ecosystem go`). Root directory defaults to $BGRAPH_EVAL_DIR/t2/go: full clones <dir> (core.autocrlf=false) at R, oracle.jsonl, GOCACHE gocache-<dir> per repo (incremental builds), GOMODCACHE from the environment, GOFLAGS=-mod=mod, CGO_ENABLED=0, TEMP/TMP/GOTMPDIR=<dir root>/tmp, GOTOOLCHAIN=auto (go1.26 toolchains come from the module cache). Suite: `go test -json -count=1 ./...` in every module of the repo (every go.mod outside vendor/testdata/./_ dirs); the unit is the package directory `go:<dir>` and is red when its package-level event is `fail` (failed test, crashed binary, or the package / its tests failed to build or vet). A mutant is nocompile when `go build` of the mutated package fails (no suite run). Baseline = 2 runs at R; a unit failing in both runs is excluded unless a top-level test outside its baseline failing set fails; differing units are excluded. Red units are re-run once (`go test` of just those packages) to confirm. Mutants: one-token flips (==/!=, </>=, >/<=, <=/>, >=/<, &&/||, +/-, true/false) found with go/parser in non-test, non-generated .go files that match the host build context (windows/amd64, cgo off). `mutants` = killed mutants aimed at, `tries` = mutants generated at most. Candidates dropped: go-chi/chi and BurntSushi/toml (fewer than 5 package units with tests), spf13/afero (7 units but most code sits in the root package, whose symlink tests fail at R on this host).
